corrections.title: Removed things the drawing does not show
corrections.detail: A 50 in "foyer to living room" opening and a front-door swing were artifacts: the drawing has a solid wall there, and the small walled space is now listed as an entry closet or nook. Two kitchen "openings" were split by the dark peninsula; it is one 43 in walkway on the left.

corrections.title: Fixtures are drawn shifted by the 3D view
corrections.detail: Anything shorter than the walls appears pushed toward the camera (south-east) and looks deeper because its front faces show. Drawn clearances around the toilet, vanity, washer/dryer and kitchen were biased; the estimates use your tape plus standard fixture depths.

corrections.title: Shower end wall moved 3.8 in toward the door
corrections.detail: Your tape (69.5 in + 49.5 in) adds to the room depth exactly, and the plan draws that wall where the 4 in shelf face would be. Best estimate uses your tape.

corrections.title: Closet and laundry share that wall
corrections.detail: If the wall really is 3.8 in further from the back wall, the walk-in closet is about 45 in deep and the laundry about 69 in. Tape these two before buying shelving or appliances.

corrections.title: Door widths are standard-size assumptions
corrections.detail: The render covers every doorway with a header and draws 3D leaning door leaves, so no door width could be measured. Swing arcs use typical sizes.

corrections.title: Fixtures use typical sizes
corrections.detail: Toilets, washer/dryer, tub, fridge and vanity are stock 3D symbols. Real appliances listed for this plan (full-size laundry, side-by-side fridge) are larger than drawn.

corrections.title: Total area is 8% under the listing
corrections.detail: Plan footprint is 1,287 sq ft (outside of exterior walls, garage excluded) against 1,400-1,401 listed. The bathroom tape rules out a simple scale error there, so rooms away from the bathroom carry an upward-skewed range of about +4%. One tape measurement in the living room or bedroom 2 would settle it.
